deployment_notes: Do not run manual `wrangler pages deploy`; it hangs on asset upload. Push to main instead.
API deploy with wrangler works normally.
After adding ports: build, run node api/scripts/gen-port-ids.mjs, deploy API, then commit/push site.
Verify Pages deployment status through Cloudflare API or wait for the .pages.dev URL.
Cloudflare CDN can serve an older HTML briefly; verify with cache-busting and a fresh browser.
constraints: AGENTS.md stack is fixed: TypeScript, Hono, D1, Drizzle, Better Auth, zod, vitest.
AGENTS.md currently says social OAuth only, NO passwords. Email signup conflicts with this; decide magic-link/OTP vs changing the rule.
Never return email or provider ids in any public API response; public user shape is {id, name, image}.
Validate every input with zod; Drizzle parameterized queries only; generic errors.
Comment body is plain text; never HTML.
CSRF: unsafe requests require allowed Origin; CORS allowlist with credentials.
No secrets in chat, code, or commits.
Never edit TS/CSS with PowerShell Set-Content/Get-Content defaults: it corrupted UTF-8 and produced mojibake. Use the Edit/Write tools or Node with explicit UTF-8.
Do not mass-read src/content/ports, public/logos, .agents, node_modules, out, .next.
known_issues: Some strings were mojibake; fixed in dictionaries/admin/login and port files. Recheck if new Spanish strings look wrong.
Profile photos are URL-only; no upload/R2 yet.
No catalog-public filters by rating/comment count yet (only admin users sorting).
Reviews are comments with sentiment; multiple reviews per user are possible and can skew percentages.
No email notifications, chat, or real-time updates.
Guides are one page with sections, not separate pages.
Moderation lacks audit log, search in reports, bulk actions, and author notifications.

options: Magic link / email OTP with Better Auth emailOTP (recommended; still no passwords; needs transactional email provider such as Resend, Postmark, SES, or Cloudflare Email)
Email + password by changing AGENTS.md (requires hashing, verification, reset, stricter rate limits)
